caption:
‘Confidence Is Something You Grow With’ - Yang Mun 

#yangmun #usahealth #wellness #american #newyork
transcript: My friend, confidence is not something you are born with, it is something you grow. The way bamboo grows, quietly at first, then all at once. When doubt fills your mind, remember this, a river never questions its flow, it simply moves forward, even around the stones that try to stop it. Confidence begins with three simple practices. First, keep the small promises you make to yourself. When you say, today I will take one step, and you truly take it, your spirit learns to trust you again. Second, speak to yourself with patience, not punishment. Even the strongest warrior collapses when his inner voice becomes his enemy. Third, do uncomfortable things, not to impress the world, but to strengthen your own soul. Every time you face discomfort, your inner fire expands. Like steel in the heat, you grow harder to break. Remember, my friend, true confidence is quiet. It does not shout, it does not beg for approval. It is the calm knowing that you are enough, and that you will keep rising, no matter who doubts you. If you reached until this part, comment, I'm here.
